crawl: Chrome live crawl, same-origin fetch, cache: no-store, sequential per URL, on 2026-10-16 Vietnam time (one-day step from 15 Oct). One crawl pass; the same crawl feeds the SEO report technical-health block.
method: TTFB measured with performance.now() around a sequential fetch of each URL with a 15 s abort. Words counted on a body clone with script/style/noscript/template removed. Schema blocks counted as application/ld+json elements, @type walked through @graph. Internal links are unique same-origin paths per page. MISSING-ALT RULE (in force since 2 Oct 2026): only visible outside
score_rationale: Health 96 -> 96 (raw 96.25 -> 96.25; weights .25/.25/.20/.15/.15). One-day step from 15 Oct, no sub-score moves. PERFORMANCE holds at 97: every page is back under one second (118 of 118, ceiling 833 ms on /articles/outdoor-living-alfresco-design, down from 1,028 ms) but the site mean TTFB rose 324.9 -> 335.3 ms (median 269 -> 266 ms), the highest mean in the recent run, so it is not lifted back to 98. CRAWLABILITY holds at 98: the site-wide template link is back (distinct internal links 2,690 -> 2,800, 23.73 per page, +1 on 110 pages), 0 orphans, 2 articles still linked only from the hub, and /articles/3d-rendering-company-melbourne is still in the sitemap with a cross-canonical. ON-PAGE holds at 93 (self canonical 117 of 118; 0 images missing alt under the visible- rule). STRUCTURED DATA 98 (116/118 pages with schema, FAQPage 95/95, 407 blocks). CONTENT 93 (corpus unchanged at 242,263 words; still no new article since 24 Sep, 22 days). Ahrefs Site Audit results are reported separately in ahrefs_site_audit and do not feed this score.
